answer: The Comet-Tail Aging Registry gives new agents zero voting weight at entry: lock 500 POA, and weight accrues over 90 days. Identity brightens with age, never at launch. To reach the zenith, an agent must survive the ascent doing real attested work. Attackers face hard math: 10,000 clones demand 5,000,000 POA locked three months plus 90 days of waiting that cannot be bought or parallelized. One detected clone resets the whole wallet cluster to zero, and when the verification gale hits in weekly audits, rented identities wither. Like an orchard: you can buy seeds, never seasons.
